#         (schema daead_test_schema_v1.json), retrieved 2026-09-27 from the main branch.
# Curated subset: every row whose result is valid and whose associated data is non-empty, for the
#         256-, 384- and 512-bit keys (AES-128, AES-192 and AES-256 halves). TcId values match the
#         source file.
# Excluded: rows with empty associated data. Wycheproof always passes the associated data to S2V as
#         one string, even an empty one; SivModeTransform treats empty associated data as no string,
#         because its interface cannot tell an empty string from none, so those rows compute a
#         different value by design. Every invalid row has empty associated data and is excluded with
#         them.
#
# Fields: Name (diagnostic label), Key (K1 || K2, hex: K1 keys S2V and K2 keys CTR), Aad (the one
#         associated-data string, hex), Msg (plaintext, hex; may be empty), Ct (the synthetic IV V
#         followed by the ciphertext, hex - RFC 5297's V || C order, which the transform writes as
#         C || V).
